scope: Proposition 4.3 of the manuscript “The abelianity conjecture for special compact Kähler manifolds” (preprints/The-abelianity-conjecture-for-special-compact-Kahler-manifolds-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 057 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dfbf9ad2335b9d20), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 24. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There exist an integer p > 0, a separable unitary representation ρ : Q → U(H) with no nonzero finite-dimensional invariant subspace, and a nonzero holomorphic section η ∈ H0 Y, Ωp Y ⊗ Hρ  .
